messages:
Jo Park: Heads up — BlueRidge asked for Private deployment with Dedicated pricing but insists on no outbound egress and quarterly security attestations. looking for something we can standardize into the pricebook rather than a bespoke SOW.
Tariq Ahmed: Sales wants two neat options: "Commit-Heavy" (higher GPU commit, low ops fee) and "Ops-Heavy" (lower commit, per-node ops + PS). keeps procurement happy.
Priya Nair: Eng: airgap work requires signed offline bundles, manual upgrade playbook, and disabled webhook/streaming features. ongoing ops delta ~20% if we do per-node support.
Oliver Stone (Finance): Financial view: per-node ops fee gives predictable margin coverage. recommend minimum 12-month commit for Commit-Heavy and amortize install PS across Y1 for Ops-Heavy.
Valerie Kim (Legal): Contract note: "no egress" must be narrowly defined. propose Annex A enumerating approved endpoints and Annex B for maintenance/change-control. will draft safe default language.
Jo Park: Proposed product approach: create an "Airgap Compliance" add-on SKU with two tiers: Lite (per-node ops + commit) and Pro (flat surcharge + PS days). include explicit UI flag "airgap mode" to hide integrations.
Tariq Ahmed: Can we publish example pricing cells? need GPU commit tiers, $/node/mo, flat surcharge %, PS day rate, and recommended discounts for 2/3-year commits. quote-bot: I can generate initial grid if provided numbers.
Priya Nair: Engineering estimate (minimal viable): signed package pipeline (2 sprints), Console toggle + quota surfaces (1 sprint), offline diagnostics + runbook (1 sprint) — total ~4 sprints. If we delay automated updates, shave 1 sprint.
Oliver Stone (Finance): Also note billing implications: separate invoice lines for commit vs node-maintenance vs one-time install. Revenue recognition team needs heads-up.
Valerie Kim (Legal): Starter clause: "Customer shall operate Redwood Private in a network that prevents outbound connections except to endpoints listed in Annex A. Redwood will not transmit Customer data to Redwood-owned services absent Customer consent; telemetry is strictly opt-in." will post redline.
Jo Park: Next steps: Tariq to get two price options for customer demo; Priya to paste a 1-page runbook checklist; Valerie to upload legal annex draft; Oliver to sanity-check margins. Aim EOD for artifacts to present Wed. :tada:
